feed.title: The Godfather: what’s new in the Ahmed Khaled Tawfik archive
feed.subtitle: Everything added to the site or changed in it: new pages, covers, recordings and corrections.

entry.title: Data, sitemap, feeds and service worker rebuilt and checked
entry.content: Data, sitemap, feeds and service worker rebuilt and checked: 57 pages and 9 redirects, every page in sitemap.xml (1,601 addresses) and no redirect in it, no internal link to a missing page or to a redirect, sitemap.xml, feed.xml and feed-en.xml well formed, the service worker's 273 files all there, the manifest's icons and shortcuts all there; every page loads at 1280 and 390 wide with no script error, no sideways scroll and no broken picture (median 428 ms locally). The changelog's Arabic line added for the seven rebuilds that had none

entry.title: «ركن القرّاء» (quiz.html) is gone, its six parts each a page of its own, all six in «شارك»'s panel under…
entry.content: «ركن القرّاء» (quiz.html) is gone, its six parts each a page of its own, all six in «شارك»'s panel under «العب واقرأ» beside the ways to add to the site (and in the phone's menu): «اختبر نفسك» (test.html, its fan of question cards), «أي شخصية أنت؟» (which-character.html: a band of the six characters in gilt oval frames, one lit at a time with what makes them so), «البدايات» (first-lines.html: a sheet in a typewriter, a first line typed on it a letter at a time and then «…من أي كتاب؟»), «بطاقة القارئ» (reader-card.html: a library borrowing card, his books down it, their years stamped in red, a round «قارئ» stamp), «صمّم غلافك» (cover-maker.html: pocket covers in his series' looks, untitled, the reader's own in the middle with its title a blinking caret) and «اقرأ معنا» (read-with-us.html: the months as a row of covers, this month's book raised and lit). quiz.html leads to them, #who, #openings, #card, #cover and #club each to its page; the shared pictures and invitations carry the new addresses; «إرثه»'s panel and the footer no longer list it; the site map, sitemap.xml and the search words name the six

entry.content: «الإرث» without «على الشاشة»: the adaptations' cards are gone from legacy.html, and its lead and description no longer name them — the farewell and tributes, then his interviews and talks

entry.title: «لقاءاته» has a new video
entry.content: «لقاءاته» has a new video: «ليه كتابات أحمد خالد توفيق مهمة؟», Tarek Osman on why his writing matters, on his YouTube channel (31 January 2025, 10 minutes) — 62 interviews, films and articles now, 29 of them videos that play on the page; in «سيرته»'s last chapter too

entry.title: «شارك» in the main menu in the site's own colours
entry.content: «شارك» in the main menu in the site's own colours: no longer a gold, glowing pill but the ember of the rest of the bar — filled, flat, the twin of «من أين أبدأ؟» beside it (outlined), the pen before its word; its panel's icons, its seal and its note on credit in ember and the site's ink too

entry.title: «حكايات القرّاء» and «بخط يده» are one page, «حكايات القرّاء وبخط يده» (reader-stories.html)
entry.content: «حكايات القرّاء» and «بخط يده» are one page, «حكايات القرّاء وبخط يده» (reader-stories.html): his readers and him, both ways — the readers' stories with their reel and how to send one, then «بخط يده» (#hand): what he wrote by hand for his readers, his books' printed dedications (#dedications) and the card-form for a dedication of one's own (#send); chips at the top to each part. One band for both: «بخط يده»'s ruled sheet in the middle, the pen writing «إلى القارئ العزيز.. ابق حيًا حتى اللقاء القادم» and signing it, and the readers' polaroids of his covers tossed around it, never over the writing (on a phone, smaller, a column each side); the sheet leads to «بخط يده». handwriting.html leads to the page, keeping #dedications and #send; the menus, the search words, the site map, sitemap.xml, the description and the GitHub form's note name the one page

entry.title: «دراسات ورسائل عنه» is a page of its own (studies.html), no longer the end of «قالوا عنه»
entry.content: «دراسات ورسائل عنه» is a page of its own (studies.html), no longer the end of «قالوا عنه»: the 35 theses and peer-reviewed articles about him, theses first and journal articles beside them, each with where and when, its record's link and the book it reads, and a chip for each country (Egypt 15, Algeria 9, Iran 3…). Its band: the nine theses bound in cloth on a wooden shelf, their years in gold on the spines and the doctorate the tallest, the journals stacked beside them under their count; each leads to its entry. tributes.html#studies leads to it; in «إرثه»'s panel, the footer, the search words, the site map, sitemap.xml and its own description

entry.title: «سيرته ولقاءاته» splits into three pages
entry.content: «سيرته ولقاءاته» splits into three pages: «سيرته» (talks.html) keeps his life in six chapters and gets a band of its own — his life as one line, a stretch for each chapter as long as its years, each leading to it; «لقاءاته» (interviews.html) takes the interviews, talks, films and articles with the wall of old television sets; «طنطا، مدينته» (tanta.html) is a page again, under a band of the town at dusk, the Badawi mosque among its roofs, 1962 and 2018 at its sides. Old links to talks.html#talks and #tanta lead to the new pages, and a year's video in «سيرته» goes to its card on «لقاءاته». In «حياته»'s panel, the phone's menu, the footer, the search words, the site map, sitemap.xml and the descriptions. And «في مثل هذا اليوم» leaves the calendar page, since the calendar's open day already shows it

entry.title: «أعلام في حكاياته» has a new band
entry.content: «أعلام في حكاياته» has a new band: an investigation board — cork in a wooden frame — of the nine issues where several of its figures meet: each issue's cover pinned, the names met in it on paper tags above and below it (their years beside them, a line of their kind's colour on top), a red thread from the cover to each — Pasteur with Koch, Loeffler, Yersin, Hansen and Reed; Freud, Adler and Jung; Verne and Wells; Ross, Manson and Grassi… A tag leads to its card, a cover to its issue; «التقوا في عدد واحد» on a brass plate in the frame. Each group as wide as its names need, nothing over anything; on a phone the board scrolls sideways in its frame

entry.title: «شارك» in the main menu
entry.content: «شارك» in the main menu: the reader's turn, in gold — filled, a pen before its word — after «من أين أبدأ؟», opening a panel of every way to give: a correction or an addition on GitHub, a cover, a dedication, a recording or an article to send, one's own story with his books, what the archive is missing, code, and the open data; beside them, a word that each contribution goes up in its sender's name, in «سجل التحديثات». Marked when on «تواصل وساهم» or «ما ينقص الأرشيف»; in the phone's menu too, leading to «ساهم معنا»

entry.content: «أعداء وأشرار» moves from «السلاسل جنبًا إلى جنب» to each series' own page: on «ما وراء الطبيعة» its 10 (Franz Lucifer, Mother Marsha, Ronel the Black, the other Refaat…), on «سافاري» its 4, on «فانتازيا» its 3 — after the characters, a card each with its note, the covers of the issues it is in and its sources, at #v-<id> (series.html?id=mwt#v-franz-lucifer). entry.content: «مكتبة رفعت إسماعيل» is a page of its own (refaat-library.html), no longer a part of «مكتبته»: what his heroes read, quote, watch and hum inside the stories, by hero — Refaat Ismail 16, Alaa Abdel Azim 3 — a heading each, and by kind; each with how they use it and the issues it is in (AKT.refaatLibrary). Its band: their books standing on a shelf in the light of Refaat's lantern, each spine leading to its card. In «عالمه»'s panel, the footer's «عالم العرّاب», the phone's menu, the site map and sitemap.xml; library.html#refaat leads to it

entry.content: «عوالم فانتازيا» and «عيادة سافاري» list their issues by kind, a heading each — «أساطير وملاحم 9», «أمراض وأوبئة 12», … «لم نعرف بعد» — with its count, and its issues under it in their order, not one run in the series' order; each card says its issue's number, its kind being the heading over it. The kinds above still show one group at a time, and #fantasia-25 still goes to its card

entry.content: «خط زمن فانتازيا» (worlds.html) is a carousel: previous and next buttons at its ends, as the rows of covers have — the site's own (App.carousels, which now takes any row marked data-carousel), hidden at an end it has reached — and its scrollbar shows only while it moves, fading a moment after, its room kept so the line never jumps

entry.title: The day his translations and stories for others came out, sent by the site's editor
entry.content: The day his translations and stories for others came out, sent by the site's editor: «رجفة الخوف»'s ten issues — 1 on 19 January 2003, 2 on 26 May 2003, 3 on 15 January 2004, 4 on 2 January 2005, 5 on 15 December 2005, 6 in 2006, 7 on 11 June 2007, 8 on 5 January 2008, 9 on 15 July 2008, 10 on 27 December 2009 — and the series' years, 2003–2009; «ثلاثة» in «كتاب الصيف» on 28 May 2003; «أسطورة بلية» (بلية العجيب 17) on 5 June 2004. Each as its issue's first edition, with its year: on its page, in «السلاسل جنبًا إلى جنب», and on its day in «تقويم العرّاب» and «في مثل هذا اليوم» (990 moments now)

entry.title: «زمن العرّاب» (era.html) is gone
entry.content: «زمن العرّاب» (era.html) is gone: the page, its script, its stylesheet, its share picture and its data (AKT.era, the 91 events of the world around him, in data-pages.js); out of «حياته»'s panel, the footer's «اكتشف أكثر», the phone's menu, the site map's tree and sitemap.xml, and the README. Its address now leads to «سيرته ولقاءاته», as the site's other retired pages lead to theirs. «عوالم فانتازيا» no longer loads that data — its timeline reads each world's own era

entry.title: Two videos about him on «الإرث» (AKT.media)
entry.content: Two videos about him on «الإرث» (AKT.media): «كل يوم» on ON, a segment on «العرّاب» in the days after his death (5 April 2018, 38 minutes), and «آخر النهار» on Al Nahar, Ibrahim Eissa speaking of him (29 November 2020, 8 minutes); each also under its year on «ذكراه كل عام». «أعلام في حكاياته» has a new band: a frieze of the 42 names — three rows sliding slowly, each the other way, the middle one in outline, the most met first — beside each the years they lived, taken from their note, and a dot in the colour of their kind; a row stops under the pointer and a name leads to its card, as before. No names over one another now, and the title closer under it

entry.title: «روايات عالمية للجيب» has its years
entry.content: «روايات عالمية للجيب» has its years: 66 of its issues dated from their own Goodreads editions (the Arabic edition's date, not the original novel's) — one about every three months from #8 (April 1994) to #74 (October 2010), then #75–80 from 2012 to January 2015 (AKT.otherSeries, issue.year, data-series-more.js). Left out where Goodreads gives only the original's date (13, 18, 25, 35, 42, 43, 81) or a date out of turn (68); 1–7 and 82–83 not found. «السلاسل جنبًا إلى جنب» shows 1994–2015 «from #8 to #80, as their editions date them», and the series has its lane in the band, with its 77 issues; each issue's year shows on its series page

entry.title: «السلاسل جنبًا إلى جنب» has «روايات عالمية للجيب», the line of world novels he translated and adapted from…
entry.content: «السلاسل جنبًا إلى جنب» has «روايات عالمية للجيب», the line of world novels he translated and adapted from its 7th issue to its 83rd: his part in it in place of a narrator, its 77 issues (#7–83), the first and the last with their covers, its house and its kind; its issues are read where a series by others keeps them (AKT.otherSeries), as every series page does. Its years are not known yet, so it has a dash there and no lane in the band; a line of separate novels has no ending of its own, so a dash there too. «السلاسل السبع» now, counted

entry.title: «حكايات القرّاء»
entry.content: «حكايات القرّاء»: its band is now his covers tossed on the page as polaroids, after Toc's «Scattered Polaroids — CSS random()»: two dozen issues and novels, each a little off true, turned and shadowed its own way, placed where it covers no other by more than about a third, dropping in one after another; one under the pointer lifts and straightens. On the page itself — no ground of its own and no line under it. The reel's arrows are drawn chevrons: the ❮ ❯ characters were mirrored by right-to-left text, so in Arabic they pointed against the way their buttons go

entry.title: «ذكراه كل عام»
entry.content: «ذكراه كل عام»: the candles stand on the page itself — no ground of their own and no line under them, in either theme, only a warm light around the flames, and the title closer under them. «حكايات القرّاء» opens on a reel of polaroids, after two pens — Chris Bolson's «Scroll-Driven Photo Gallery» (white polaroids with a handwritten caption growing out of nothing as they scroll into place, markers and arrows between them) and Toc's «Stacked Card Scroll Effect» (each card, once seen, scaling down and flying out along a curve, turning, onto a stack): as the page scrolls, each polaroid rises full size to the middle, then flies onto one of two piles, one each side. Until a story is published they are his covers asking a story's questions — «أول عدد قرأته له؟» on Ma Wara' al-Tabi'a 1, «من أعطاك إياه؟», «أين كنت تقرؤه؟», «ماذا ترك فيك؟» on Utopia, «هل التقيته؟» on his photograph, «أين كنت يوم رحل؟» on his grave — and a blank one, «حكايتك هنا», that leads to writing it; then the stories themselves. The captions in Aref Ruqaa (SIL OFL, kept on the site); still, as a row on a table, for those who ask for less motion

entry.title: A look over the whole site
entry.content: A look over the whole site. The twelve pages about his world and his reading load only their own part of data-pages.js — «وحوش وأساطير» its monsters, «زمن العرّاب» its years — written by tools/build-data.js to assets/js/pages/<part>.js (each page about 50–75 KB lighter compressed; «اقتباسات» needs none, its phrases being in data-built.js already), and the offline copy no longer stores data-pages.js whole; its stale first copy of Fantasia's worlds, overridden by the second, is gone. «الأعمال» and «من أين أبدأ؟» load the same GSAP as the home page (3.13.0, jsDelivr), so a reader downloads it once. «حفظ للقراءة دون اتصال» says how much it saves as measured at each build (about 55 MB, AKT.stats.offlineMB), not «about 100 MB». The app's screenshots for installing it are new — the home page, the legacy, the cassette, the works and the characters as they look now, with the new menu (the phone ones at a true 412 px). Checked: every page's title, description, canonical, share tags and picture and structured data agree; every script and stylesheet a page names exists; every page draws without an error; the sitemap, the feeds and the service worker rebuilt

entry.title: After him, five new parts
entry.content: After him, five new parts. «ما صدر بعد رحيله» on the Works page (#after, posthumous.js): the ten books that came out after 2 April 2018, from «أفراح المقبرة» to «ألغام في بحر الذكريات», each with its date, how long after his death, its kind and its house. «الجيل الذي صنعه» on «دائرته» (#generation): fourteen writers and filmmakers who say they grew up on his books, a face and what each said with its source, each to their page. «الوداع، يومًا بيوم» on «قالوا عنه» (#farewell): from Monday 2 April 2018 to the end of May, each day with its events and the faces of those who spoke of him that day, opening their cards. «ذكراه كل عام» (remembrance.html), a new page: every anniversary from the first in 2019 to the eighth, each with the year's events, books, tributes and articles, the anniversary's own day marked, the days to the next one, and a band of a candle a year. «حكايات القرّاء» (reader-stories.html), a new page, and a step of «تواصل وساهم» (#stories): readers' own stories of him, sent by email or on GitHub and published only with leave (AKT.readerStories, data-readers.js — none yet). The two pages are in «إرثه»'s panel, under «اكتشف أكثر», in the phone's menu and on the site map

entry.title: The main menu
entry.content: The main menu: World Fiction floats along «من أين أبدأ؟» with its own front cover (covers/fronts/rwg.webp); Refaat's card is in the dark, as his page is, so his lantern's light shows; Alaa's heartbeat is drawn at the card's scale — a wide line squeezed into it had thinned the beat to nothing — brighter, its beat at the row's start (the right in Arabic) and the line running from it behind him

entry.title: «كلمة اليوم · بكلماته» moves from the home page to the Works page, under «في مثل هذا اليوم» (as that one did…
entry.content: «كلمة اليوم · بكلماته» moves from the home page to the Works page, under «في مثل هذا اليوم» (as that one did before it): the same line of his for everyone on the same day — a quote or a phrase from «قاموس العرّاب», in turn — with its place on the quotes page and «صورة», now drawn by today.js

entry.title: «حياته» in the main menu
entry.content: «حياته» in the main menu: a new photograph of him (assets/img/photos/akt-portrait-cafe.webp), and on it a new line of his each time the panel opens — his wish for his headstone or one of the short quotes from his books (AKT.quotes, 120 letters at most, never the same twice running) with the book it is from; on the pages that do not load the data, his wish. The photograph now leads to «اقتباسات»

entry.title: «أعماله» in the main menu
entry.content: «أعماله» in the main menu: his books float along «من أين أبدأ؟» at its foot — the three series' first covers, his six novels, WWW and World Fiction, each opening its own page — in place of the shelf under the covers; and the series' cards carry the footer's night, each its own part of it: Ma Wara' al-Tabi'a the haunted hill with its lit castle, its three bats, eyes in the dark and fog; Fantasia the moon with the witch riding across it, stars and sparks from the book; Safari the sunset in the shape of Africa behind the savanna. The footer's Africa and bats are drawn by one function each, shared by the two

entry.title: The main menu's panels, fuller
entry.content: The main menu's panels, fuller: «أعماله» has a shelf under its covers — Utopia, Al-Senga, Like Icarus, In the Rats' Passage, Shaabeeb, Al-Mirante, WWW and World Fiction — and each series' card its own night behind the cover: Ma Wara' al-Tabi'a's fog, eyes that open and blink and bats crossing; Fantasia's stars, a portal turning and sparks rising; Safari's banded sun going down over the savanna's acacias. «عالمه» has «أعداء وأشرار» and «مكتبة رفعت إسماعيل», and its three heroes carry their pages' effects — Refaat's fog and his lantern glowing in his hand with moths circling it, Abeer's stars and portal, Alaa's heartbeat. «حياته» has «طنطا، مدينته»; «إرثه»'s links have their icons. The effects move only while their panel is open and stop for those who ask for less motion. A link to a whole section (#villains, #refaat) now stops at its top under the header — centred, a section taller than the window was left above sight — and «أعماله» keeps its two columns on a tablet held sideways

entry.title: The main menu, on a wider screen, is six words
entry.content: The main menu, on a wider screen, is six words — الرئيسية، أعماله، عالمه، حياته، إرثه، من أين أبدأ؟ — four of them opening a large panel under the header: «أعماله» his three series as covers on their colours, the rest as a list (all his works, side by side, covers, translations, audio, publishers) and «من أين أبدأ؟» along its foot; «عالمه» the eight pages inside his stories beside Refaat, Abeer and Alaa standing; «حياته» his life and his writing in two columns beside his photograph and his wish for his headstone; «إرثه» what he left, a still from the Netflix series and his books year by year in bars. It opens on a hover, a click, a tap, Enter or ↓, and closes on leaving it, Escape, a click outside or focus moving away; the panel holding the page you are on is marked; its pictures load on the first move towards it; the notices in the corner step aside while it is open. It is narrow enough that the header keeps one row from 1,001px (two only on a narrower tablet); the panels fold for a tablet; a phone keeps its contents page

entry.title: Tablets
entry.content: Tablets: the page no longer slides sideways — the root hides what is wider than the window and the body clips it (clip, not hidden, so the sticky header holds); with hidden alone on the body, an iPad's swipe or a jump to a card panned the whole page, header and all. «سجل التحديثات»'s search box wraps to its own row when the chips leave it no room (between 900 and 1,200 px it was pushed off the bar); «تواصل»'s email breaks inside its card; on «الشخصيات» the last column's figure has room for its overhang and is no longer cut at the window's edge

entry.title: Lighter pictures
entry.content: Lighter pictures: the photos, the library's covers, the places, the posters, the prizes, the screens, the timeline and the cassette's face that are shown at full size (not the covers, whose grids have their small copies) made no larger than they are seen — 700 px for the library, 800 for the places, 1,000 for photos — and saved again, 4.2 MB lighter in all; the thirteen that were PNG photographs are WebP now (their names in the data, the library's list, the share pages and the cassette's stylesheet with them). Lucifer is in the same issues wherever the site names him — 20, 35, 50, 62, 78, 79 and the last — on «وحوش وأساطير» (it had 34 for 35) and in the issues' characters (50 and 78 were missing), as «أعداء وأشرار» has. «من أين أبدأ؟» now says some three hundred issues and fifty books, not «more than two hundred»

entry.title: «السلاسل جنبًا إلى جنب» (compare.html), a new page among those made from the data
entry.content: «السلاسل جنبًا إلى جنب» (compare.html), a new page among those made from the data: his six series in one table — who tells each, its years and issues, the first and the last, its house, its kind, how many are heard on Audiohat and Storytel, its legends, real figures and enemies, the screen, and its ending (on the series page, #ending, or asked for) — its band the series' lives as lanes from first year to last, a mark for each issue; and under it «أعداء وأشرار» (#villains): 17 enemies his heroes meet, by series — Lucifer, Mother Marsha, Ronel the Black, the other Refaat, Abraham Levy, Mira Goran, Rasputin, Hassan-i Sabbah… — each with its issues and sources (AKT.villains). «زمن العرّاب» (era.html), a new page: his life, his books and his series as they began and ended, his awards and the screen, year by year from 1962, beside 91 events in Egypt, the Arab world and the world, in culture and in science, each sourced; 22 tied to what he wrote of them — his column on the blog or his issue — its band the years as two tracks, his and the world's (AKT.era). «بخط يده» has «إهداءات كتبه» (#dedications): the printed dedications of four of his books — to his readers, pirated or not; to his father and Sami El-Salamouni; to Ahmed Mourad, Ayman El-Gendy and Raef Wasfy; and «السنجة»'s to Ahmed El-Aidy and the revolution (AKT.dedications). «مكتبته» has «مكتبة رفعت إسماعيل» (#refaat): 19 things his heroes read, quote, watch and hum inside the stories — Dracula, Poe, Dante, Umm Kulthum, Frankenstein, the Necronomicon, Carmina Burana, Frost, Darwish… — with their issues (AKT.refaatLibrary). «قالوا عنه» has, after «كتب عنه», «دراسات ورسائل عنه» (#studies): 35 theses and journal articles about him from ten countries, each linked to its record (AKT.studies). «ركن القرّاء» has «البدايات» (#openings): the first line of 27 of his books and issues, and four covers to choose which it opens (AKT.openings)

entry.title: «بياناتك على هذا الجهاز» (privacy.html#mydata)
entry.content: «بياناتك على هذا الجهاز» (privacy.html#mydata): everything the site keeps in this browser, read live as the page opens — the lists with how many in each, the language, the theme, the last change seen in the changelog, the offline save, the install invitation and the reading time it counts, what is forgotten when the browser closes, and the offline copy with how many files and about how much room — each with a key to clear it; all of it saved to a JSON file and loaded in another browser or device (the lists' own export loads too), or cleared at once. The privacy page's text now names every thing kept, and points there. The changelog's news is an Atom feed, feed.xml in Arabic and feed-en.xml in English, the newest 60 changes with their kinds (tools/build-feed.js, run by build-sw.js), linked from the changelog and from every page's head. And the outside links are checked on the 1st of every month by GitHub (.github/workflows/links.yml): it runs tools/check-links.js, commits the new links.json, and opens an issue for the links that died since the last check (check-links.js --report=FILE)

entry.title: «قصة الموقع» (story.html), a new page in «خلف الكواليس»
entry.content: «قصة الموقع» (story.html), a new page in «خلف الكواليس»: the site's history a day at a time from its first, 19 October — the pages born each day, the covers added, how many changes and of what kind, and the day's two headline changes (assets/data/story.json, built from git by tools/build-story.js); its band the days as a skyline, a column as tall as each day's changes, flagged where a page was born. «سجل التحديثات» opens on «ما الجديد منذ زيارتك»: what came since the newest change this reader saw there (kept on their device), with «show only what is new»; until they look, the changelog's link in the footer and the side menu carries a dot (App.LATEST, written into app.js by build-changelog.js). Under the log, «سجل التصحيحات» (#corrections): seven facts the site had wrong and put right — Lasheen's characters, his last book, the World Pocket issues he translated, issue numbers, «كتاب المقبرة»'s 2013 edition, a borrowed cover, the pocket series' publisher — from tools/corrections.json, and from now on a «correction: …» line in a commit's body. «المصادر» has «روايات متضاربة» (#disputes): five places the sources disagree, what each says with its link and what the site goes by (AKT.disputes). «حقوق الاستخدام» has «كيف تستشهد بالموقع» (#cite): a page's reference in Arabic, APA, MLA and BibTeX with the day it was seen, ready to copy, opened from a new «استشهد» key on book, series, character and writer pages. And «ما ينقص الأرشيف» lists the outside links that no longer answer, each with its Wayback Machine copies, and counts the links that work among its bars (assets/data/links.json, from tools/check-links.js, run by hand: 1,898 links, 3 gone)

entry.title: «أعلام في حكاياته» (names.html), a new page in «عالم العرّاب»
entry.content: «أعلام في حكاياته» (names.html), a new page in «عالم العرّاب»: the 42 real and legendary figures his issues' back covers name — Shakespeare, Dostoevsky, al-Mutanabbi, Hannibal, Che Guevara, Freud, Pasteur, Gilgamesh… — who each was, and the covers of the issues you meet them in (AKT.storyPeople, data-pages.js); by kind or searched, its band a sky of their names. «عوالم فانتازيا» has «خط زمن فانتازيا»: the 22 worlds of history and legend in the order they are set, from Gilgamesh (c. 2700 BC) to Che Guevara. Every series page has «النهاية»: its last issue, and how it ended behind a button that gives it away — «ما وراء الطبيعة»'s from 3rabica (AKT.seriesEndings); the others ask for theirs. «ما ينقص الأرشيف» opens on «حالة الأرشيف», a bar for how complete each part is, and lists the series whose ending is not written. «تواصل وساهم» has three more steps: «ساهم بالكود» (fork, the data files, check and build, try it, send a pull request), «البيانات مفتوحة» (issues, books, editions, quotes, phrases and the calendar as CSV files, built by tools/build-open.js into assets/data/open/, kept out of the offline copy) and «دليل الاستخدام» (search, lists, links, pictures, the app, the paper theme)

entry.title: «ما ينقص الأرشيف» has the side menu of the pages about the site, as «عن الموقع» and the rest do, and is in it…
entry.content: «ما ينقص الأرشيف» has the side menu of the pages about the site, as «عن الموقع» and the rest do, and is in it on each of them, after «تواصل وساهم»

entry.title: Four new pages
entry.content: Four new pages. «عوالم فانتازيا» (worlds.html): the world each of Fantasia's 64 issues takes Abeer to — myths, books, film and comics, history, ideas, games — 54 of them from the issues' own back covers, a few from their titles alone (and marked so), ten not known yet; its band is Abeer's train to Fantasia, a cover in each carriage window. «عيادة سافاري» (clinic.html): Safari's 53 issues as Dr Alaa's case files — the disease, tribe or place, experiment or mystery of each — with a short medical note on the twelve diseases the series names (kala-azar, malaria, leprosy, rabies, yellow fever…); its band a heart monitor whose readings are those diseases. Both in AKT.fantasiaWorlds and AKT.safariCases (data-pages.js), drawn by series-file.js; #fantasia-25, #safari-36 go to one issue. «تقويم العرّاب» (calendar.html): the whole year in small squares, darker where more happened, 979 moments on 336 days from assets/data/days/; a day chosen shows its moments, #d-06-10 opens one, by kind; its band twelve tear-off sheets. «ما ينقص الأرشيف» (wanted.html): what the archive lacks, counted from the data each time it opens — the worlds and cases not known, issues without their back-cover text, back covers no one has sent, editions with no year, text with no English — each with why and how to send it; linked from «تواصل وساهم». In the footer (عالم العرّاب, اكتشف أكثر, خلف الكواليس), the phone menu, the site map, search and sitemap.xml, each with its share picture and a description counted from the data

entry.title: Lighter grids and steadier pages
entry.content: Lighter grids and steadier pages. Every cover has a small copy now (assets/img/covers-s/, at most 320 px wide, made by tools/build-thumbs.js on every build), and the grids, shelves, map, quiz cards and the covers band show it instead of the full cover (App.thumb); the book pages still show the cover itself. The pages no longer drop as they load: the header's place is kept before it is drawn, the works page's bookshelf band and the audio cassette keep their height, and each page's eyebrow, title, lead and section heads are written into its HTML in Arabic (tools/build-meta.js, from the page's own strings) — the home page's shift went from 0.96 to 0.04, the works page's from 1.0 to 0.002 on a phone. Privacy, contact, the changelog and 404 no longer load the data (they draw nothing from it); search, the lists and "Save for offline" fetch it there when opened. «قاموس العرّاب»'s phrases and «كلمة اليوم» can be made a picture to post, as the quotes can (assets/js/quote-image.js, shared by the three), each in its speaker's name with its issue's cover. GitHub checks the data on every push (.github/workflows/check.yml), and that data-built.js and the pages' tags were rebuilt. The 28 source scans of covers/back/New folder and five loose copies, already on the site as WebP, moved out of the published site to a folder beside the repo.

entry.title: The rest of the round
entry.content: The rest of the round. Lighter: 15 more covers between 40 and 120 KB are WebP (2.1 → 0.9 MB, every reference moved, every picture checked), and what nothing used is gone — the share pictures of the pages that became redirects (papers, glossary, editions, journey, style, tanta) and two source copies of «ما وراء الطبيعة»'s box and complete edition, kept as WebP. The phrasebook's 42 lines are in data-built.js now (19 KB), and so in the search on every page: «حتى تحترق النجوم» finds its card (quotes.html#g-0). Deep links: quotes.html#glossary-refaat opens the phrasebook on one speaker, and a speaker chosen sets it; blog.html#papers-الدستور opens «في الصحف» on one paper, and a paper chosen sets it. The home page has «كلمة اليوم» under the biography: one of his quotes or one of the phrasebook's lines in turn, the same for everyone on a day, each to its place. «المصادر» is the sources page's name everywhere now, as in the footer (its title, its share tags, the info pages' menu). Checked at phone width: no page wider than the screen

entry.title: «ركن القرّاء»
entry.content: «ركن القرّاء»: a new band — a fan of seven question cards from a round of the quiz itself (a cover, a quote, a character, a year…), each with its four answers; in turn one lifts and its right answer lights green, as the pointer does over any, and a click goes down to «اختبر نفسك». In place of the glowing question mark; the band is one with the page, no ground or line; five cards on a tablet, three on a phone

entry.title: Every page loads less
entry.content: Every page loads less: what only the book, series and «حول العالم» pages read — each edition's links, translator, credit, ISBN-10 and cover source, and the Abjjad shop links — is set apart by tools/build-data.js in assets/js/data-detail.js, which only those three load (right after data-built.js, before shared.js orders the editions), and put back into AKT there; data-built.js 1148 → 988 KB (gzip 229 → 209 KB). The data the pages see is the same as before, checked field by field (the store's editions are copied first, as some are shared between two books). The ISBNs, formats and editions stay, as the reader's collector lists keep their choices by them

entry.title: A round of every page
entry.content: A round of every page: the numbers, the tags and the speed. Each section page's description — in its meta tag, its share tags and its JSON-LD — now comes from the data (tools/build-meta.js, run by build-sw.js), so its counts are the site's own: 299 issues in 14 series and 54 books, 75 quotes and 42 phrases, 1078 articles and 869 of them in 15 papers, 695 recordings, 499 covers and 1087 editions, and so on; the stale ones set right (audio was "on Audiohat" only, «سيرته ولقاءاته» was interviews only). Every section page has the same JSON-LD now (fourteen had none), a stylesheet linked twice is linked once, and every head asks early for the two Arabic fonts and the data file. «الأرقام»'s 869 is pieces in the papers (it said articles in the archive, which holds 1078). Faster: 235 heavy PNG/JPG covers are WebP now, at most 800 px wide (the covers from 105.7 to 17.6 MB of their 108; the images 155 → 74 MB), every reference moved with them and every picture checked on disk and on the covers wall; files no page uses are left as they were. Lists below the fold (issue covers, the library, the circle, a character's links, the grave, the blog's icons) load their pictures lazily. README: the build step, the quotes and blog pages' sections

entry.title: «اقتباسات» and «قاموس العرّاب» are one page
entry.content: «اقتباسات» and «قاموس العرّاب» are one page: the phrasebook — its speakers as chips, its search, each phrase with its meaning and where it is from — now under the quotes (glossary.js as GlossarySection, drawn and wired by quotes.js), glossary.html leading to quotes.html#glossary, which lands on its heading; its band of lit phrases goes with the page. «في الصحف» and «قاموس العرّاب» leave the footer and the phone menu: both are sections now, found by the search and named on the site map (UI.sections); the XML sitemap leaves glossary.html out

entry.title: «المدونة» and «في الصحف» are one page
entry.content: «المدونة» and «في الصحف» are one page: the papers section — every outlet as a card, his pieces year by year, and the pieces themselves — now under the blog's archive (papers.js as PapersSection, drawn and wired by blog.js), papers.html leading to blog.html#papers; the menus, the home page, «الأرقام», the bands and the site map point there, and the XML sitemap leaves papers.html out. First the data: 31 pieces whose post names the paper and the day it ran («بص و طل - 25 أغسطس 2010», «الدستور - 9 مارس 2010»…) but whose source the archive had not kept now have it, from the blog's feed (the archive otherwise matches it: no post added or gone, the same labels), their misspelt months set right; two outlets come in with them, «زائد 18» and «مجلة فصول». 869 pieces in 15 outlets, 2005–2018

entry.title: «سيرته ولقاءاته»
entry.content: «سيرته ولقاءاته»: a new band — a row of old television sets, some in wood, some with rabbit ears, each tuned to one of his interviews on YouTube (his own voice first, nine, in the order they were made): its still in grey under static and scanlines, its year and name under it; the pointer tunes one in (colour, the static gone), and a click goes down to it in the list (letting go of a filter that hides it), lights it and plays it there. In place of the drawn studio; the band is one with the page, no ground, faded sides or line; six sets on a tablet, four on a phone

entry.title: «يوميات رفعت إسماعيل»
entry.content: «يوميات رفعت إسماعيل»: the wheel turns faster — the next moment every three and a half seconds (was seven), the turn itself quicker and sooner, and ten seconds' rest after one is chosen by hand (was fifteen)

entry.title: «يوميات رفعت إسماعيل»
entry.content: «يوميات رفعت إسماعيل»: the wheel turns on by itself, to the next moment every seven seconds — held while the pointer or the focus is on it, for fifteen seconds after one is chosen by hand, while the band is off screen or the tab hidden; never for those who ask for less motion. Turning by itself it takes no focus

entry.title: «يوميات رفعت إسماعيل»
entry.content: «يوميات رفعت إسماعيل»: the band is now Chris Bolson's circular timeline (CodePen vEBWwxL) — his life as a great wheel, its top half showing, each of the 37 moments a mark on its rim named by its year, its issue («ع ٢٠») or the time of his life; one chosen (a click, or the arrow keys: they are radio buttons, as in the pen), the wheel turns to bring it to the top, a line drops from it, and its title and story rise in the middle with the issue it is told in. In Arabic the next moment comes to the left. The band is one with the page (no ground, faded sides or line), and clips rather than hides its overflow, so a chosen mark's radio is focused without the band or the page being scrolled to it; on a phone a larger wheel, the marks dots but for the chosen one
